plans.objective: [DIM: structure] The rigid family is defined by the linear PDE $f''(x) = 0$ (linear functions $f(x) = ax+b$) with $w \geq 2$ samples determining two parameters, yielding a 2-dimensional solution space; the fat family is a high-degree random polynomial with $>w$ degrees of freedom, creating a high-dimensional solution space that resists small networks.

steps.description: Implement the family function for the rigid family (linear functions f(x)=ax+b) and fat family (high-degree random polynomial with >w degrees of freedom) as required by the capacity_scan protocol. The function must return normalized (N,1)-shaped arrays for training and held-out sets with y/yv scaled to O(1) to ensure the 1e-3 error threshold is meaningful. Ensure held-out points do not overlap with training points and use proper random number generation.
